note: Activity Data Export is the Activities submodule that installs the views.view.activity_log View over the parent's user_activities base table. It has three displays: default, page (path admin/config/system/activity, 'Activities Log'), and export (data_export, path admin/config/system/activity/export, CSV via views_data_export / XLS via xls_serialization). No config schema, services, permissions, or Drush of its own. Live-state cases read/write the raw views.view.activity_log config object (status, label, display page path) via the config API, which avoids Views handler/plugin discovery (a broken unrelated module can fatal during full Views handler instantiation on this shared site).

evals.prompt: After enabling the activities_data_export submodule, at what admin path can I see the activity log, and how do I export it?
evals.expected_output: The Activities Log page is at /admin/config/system/activity (the activity_log View's page display). An 'Export all activity log data' action link / the export display at /admin/config/system/activity/export downloads the log as CSV (or XLS via xls_serialization).

evals.prompt: Which Drupal View does the activities_data_export submodule provide, and what entity/base table does it list?
evals.expected_output: It installs the views.view.activity_log View over the user_activities base table (the parent Activities module's log entity). Uninstalling the submodule deletes that View.

evals.prompt: What extra modules power the CSV/XLS export in the activities_data_export submodule?
evals.expected_output: The export uses views_data_export (which supplies the data_export View display for CSV) and xls_serialization (for the XLS format), plus rest for the serialization stack; it also depends on the activities module.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is the Activities Log view (provided by activities_data_export) currently enabled? Inspect the live configuration and answer.
evals.expected_output: No, it is disabled: views.view.activity_log has status: false on the live site (drush config:get views.view.activity_log status).

evals.prompt: What is the current human-readable label (name) of the activity_log view on this site? Inspect the live view configuration and report it exactly.
evals.expected_output: The view label is 'ADE Audit Log' (views.view.activity_log:label).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Activities Log view (machine name activity_log, from the activities_data_export submodule) has been disabled, so its admin page 404s. Re-enable that view. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the activity_log view, i.e. set views.view.activity_log:status to true (via the Views UI at /admin/structure/views or by editing the config). Verified when status === true.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, move the Activities Log page (the activity_log view's page display, currently at admin/config/system/activity) to the path admin/reports/activity-log. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Change the activity_log view's 'page' display path to admin/reports/activity-log (Views UI page settings, or set views.view.activity_log display.page.display_options.path). Verified when that display's path is admin/reports/activity-log.
